newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Shares tumble over two percent in Lisbon.
newsitem.headline: Shares tumble over two percent in Lisbon.

text.p: Share prices fell over two percent in early trade on the Lisbon bourse, but business was interrupted almost immediately by technical problems, dealers said.

The PSI20 index was down 2.37 percent when business was halted. A sharp drop had been predicted after New York lost more than three percent on Friday when the Portuguese market was closed for a national holiday.
